comment: Custodian of Record ordinary-input authoring route, seed 42, standard, zero bots. Radial custody archive, 25 required guards including two Auditors and three optional guards in the cooling ring, the cage mine lesson, the lifted seal, four support nodes, three secret locations and a fresh freight departure. Accurate aim does not establish thirteen-minute pacing, 5:30 par, fresh-player or difficulty acceptance.

states.name: m08_checkpoint
states.note: Arrive at the custody checkpoint. The intake form asks whether the recall inconvenienced the service.

states.name: m08_entry_equipment
states.note: Ordinary Rifle, Shotgun, Bullets and armor before the hall. Nothing is granted from a menu.

states.name: m08_observation_secret
states.note: Climb the desk tops marked with a six to the observation cage over the checkpoint and its finite Bullets.

states.name: m08_shaft_reveal
states.note: Through the checkpoint opening: the records hall, its desks and first guards, and the low south rail of the central shaft. Steel screens close the shaft on the other three sides at this floor.

states.name: m08_records_hall_clear
states.note: Clerks and Sweepers among the records desks, the galleries stacked above.

states.name: m08_hall_arrival
states.note: At the cleared hall rail the shaft rises through both galleries to the hanging custody machine.

states.name: m08_lost_property_secret
states.note: The lost-property cage: confiscated jackets, one with the six, finite Shells and a medkit.

states.name: m08_west_stair
states.note: The west stair tower climbs to the lower gallery without a jump.

states.name: m08_lower_gallery_clear
states.note: Local guards on the lower gallery before the registry.

states.name: m08_registry
states.note: Renn waits behind the registry desk with a lowered case. Every arrival is an asset.

states.name: m08_mine_cage
states.note: Up the corridor and into the one-entrance alcove. The equipment cage grants four mines; entering dispatches two post Sweepers.

states.name: m08_mine_corridor
states.note: Step into the corridor the post must walk up and throw a mine level down it. It sticks and holds a steady arming lamp.

states.name: m08_mine_live
states.note: Step back into the corner the corridor cannot see. The live mine blinks until the post walks into it.

states.name: m08_mine_cleanup
states.note: Both post Sweepers remain required; one walks into the mine, and the last of the pair walks home to its post, where it is hunted down.

states.name: m08_east_stair
states.note: From the post, claim the Railgun and the tower armor and climb the east tower. Waking the upper gallery also counts the won mine lesson.

states.name: m08_first_custody_sweeper
states.note: Drop the nearest custody Sweeper so the Auditor has a disabled body to reach.

states.name: m08_auditor_channel
states.note: The Auditor raises its hand and a channel reaches the disabled body. A hit or broken sight snaps it.

states.name: m08_upper_auditor_clear
states.note: Beat the Auditor: break its channels, flank its plate.

states.name: m08_seal_lifted
states.note: The Auditor's fall lifts the custody seal and the upper bay shutters.

states.name: m08_lower_bays
states.note: Back down to the lower bays. Their captives walk out; Latch ticks greatly on every form.

states.name: m08_service_ambush
states.note: Back up through the lifted seal, the cooling ring's Clerks wait among the pipes and a Sweeper comes down from the bridge end: a close fight among the pipes.

states.name: m08_service_ring
states.note: The cleared cooling ring: Shells and armor at the pipe junction marked with a six.

states.name: m08_cold_cabinet
states.note: Orrin's damaged backup in the cold cabinet. Its lamp warms once taken.

states.name: m08_bridge_fight
states.note: The machinery bridge: a second Auditor repairs Sweepers in the well below while Clerks hold the far approach.

states.name: m08_node_north_west
states.note: Shoot the first glowing support node apart.

states.name: m08_node_north_east
states.note: The second node, across the bridge.

states.name: m08_node_south_west
states.note: The far nodes need the far side of the shaft: the runner's line around the galleries.

states.name: m08_node_south_east
states.note: The last node goes and the machine drops through every gallery to the floor of the shaft.

states.name: m08_machine_fallen
states.note: The wreck rests on the shaft floor, collision changed before this presentation.

states.name: m08_evidence
states.note: The transfer evidence on the bridge desk names Mars and systems several sides built.

states.name: m08_exit_counter
states.note: The counterattack converges up both enclosed freight stairs. The search follows the east flight to its actual bottom turn.

states.name: m08_authorized_noise
states.note: An empty freight car waits in the lane that nobody called. Authorized noise, no action required, with a repeating rhythm under the text.

states.name: m08_exit_arrival
states.note: Down the freight stair to the lane.

states.name: m08_departure
states.note: Board the uncalled freight car with a fresh aimed use.
